url: Official Omni Notes repository documentation and F-Droid listing
description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Omni Notes (it.feio.android.omninotes.foss), version 6.3.1.

features.name: Create a text note
features.description: Create a text note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap the back arrow to save

features.name: Create a checklist note
features.description: Create a checklist note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap the checklist option (or open a note and use the overflow menu
press Enter to add the next item
tap the back arrow to save

features.name: Tick and untick checklist items
features.description: Tick and untick checklist items as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap the checkbox beside an item to mark it done
tap it again to clear it; completed items move or are struck through according to the settings

features.name: Convert a note between text and checklist
features.description: Convert a note between text and checklist as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap "Convert to checklist" or "Convert to note"

features.name: Attach a photo from the camera
features.description: Attach a photo from the camera as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: grant the camera permission if prompted

features.name: Attach an image or video from the gallery
features.description: Attach an image or video from the gallery as documented for Omni Notes.

features.name: Record and attach an audio note
features.description: Record and attach an audio note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: the recording is attached to the note

features.name: Create and attach a sketch
features.description: Create and attach a sketch as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: use the stroke size, eraser and colour controls
tap the back arrow/save to attach the drawing

features.name: Attach an arbitrary file
features.description: Attach an arbitrary file as documented for Omni Notes.

features.name: Add a location to a note
features.description: Add a location to a note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: confirm the detected address or search for a place

features.name: Set a reminder on a note
features.description: Set a reminder on a note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap Done; the reminder fires as an Android notification

features.name: Set a recurring reminder
features.description: Set a recurring reminder as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Open the reminder dialog on a note
choose the repetition rule (for example daily, weekly, monthly, yearly or a custom rule)

features.name: View all notes that have reminders
features.description: View all notes that have reminders as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Open the navigation drawer (hamburger icon or left-edge swipe)
review the notes with scheduled alarms

features.name: Create a category
features.description: Create a category as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: enter the category name and description

features.name: Edit or delete a category
features.description: Edit or delete a category as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap Edit to change the name, description or colour, or tap Delete

features.name: Assign a category to a note
features.description: Assign a category to a note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: select the category from the list

features.name: Filter notes by category
features.description: Filter notes by category as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap the category name in the drawer list
the note list shows only the notes in that category

features.name: Tag notes with hashtags
features.description: Tag notes with hashtags as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: type a hashtag such as "#work" in the title or body (or tap the tag action in the overflow menu and pick a tag)

features.name: Filter notes by tag
features.description: Filter notes by tag as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: confirm; the list is filtered to notes carrying those tags

features.name: Search notes
features.description: Search notes as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
the note list filters as you type
tap a result to open it

features.name: Archive a note
features.description: Archive a note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: swipe the note (according to the configured swipe action) or open the note and tap the overflow menu
tap "Archive"; the note moves to the Archive section of the drawer

features.name: Restore a note from the archive
features.description: Restore a note from the archive as documented for Omni Notes.

features.name: Move a note to the trash
features.description: Move a note to the trash as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: confirm; the note moves to Trash

features.name: Restore or permanently delete notes from the trash
features.description: Restore or permanently delete notes from the trash as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap Restore to bring it back, or tap Delete permanently
confirm. Use "Empty trash" from the overflow menu to purge everything

features.name: Pin a note to the top of the list
features.description: Pin a note to the top of the list as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Long-press the note in the list
tap the pin action in the contextual toolbar; pinned notes stay above the rest

features.name: Lock a note with a password
features.description: Lock a note with a password as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: set a password and a recovery question
tap "Lock"; the note content is hidden until the password is entered

features.name: Unlock a locked note
features.description: Unlock a locked note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Tap a locked note in the list
enter the password in the prompt
tap OK to reveal the content

features.name: Merge several notes into one
features.description: Merge several notes into one as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap the additional notes to add them to the selection
tap the overflow menu in the contextual toolbar
confirm; the contents are combined into a single note

features.name: Duplicate a note
features.description: Duplicate a note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap "Duplicate"; a copy is created in the list

features.name: Share a note
features.description: Share a note as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: choose whether to include attachments if prompted
select the destination app from the Android share sheet

features.name: Add a note from another app via the share sheet
features.description: Add a note from another app via the share sheet as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: In any app, select text or a file
the content opens as a new note

features.name: Sort the note list
features.description: Sort the note list as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Tap the overflow menu (three dots) in the note list
choose the criterion (for example creation date, last modification, reminder date, title or manual/drag order)

features.name: Reorder notes manually
features.description: Reorder notes manually as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Set the sort order to manual/custom
drag it to the required position

features.name: Switch the note list between list and grid layout
features.description: Switch the note list between list and grid layout as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Tap the overflow menu in the note list
tap the layout/"Expanded view" toggle to switch between the compact list and the expanded card layout

features.name: View note details and statistics
features.description: View note details and statistics as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: read the creation date, last modification date, word and character counts and the attachment count. The global statistics screen is reachable from Settings

features.name: Add the Omni Notes home screen widget
features.description: Add the Omni Notes home screen widget as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: Long-press an empty area of the Android home screen
drag the widget onto the home screen
select the category or filter it should display

features.name: Export a full backup
features.description: Export a full backup as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: enter or confirm the backup name

features.name: Import data from a backup
features.description: Import data from a backup as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: select the backup from the list
confirm; the notes, attachments and (optionally) the settings are restored

features.name: Schedule automatic backups
features.description: Schedule automatic backups as documented for Omni Notes.

features.name: Delete an existing backup
features.description: Delete an existing backup as documented for Omni Notes.

features.name: Change the interface language
features.description: Change the interface language as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: select the language from the list

features.name: Change the app colours and theme
features.description: Change the app colours and theme as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: set the navigation drawer colour, the note-list colour behaviour and the dark/light theme options

features.name: Change the text size in the note list
features.description: Change the text size in the note list as documented for Omni Notes.

features.name: Configure the swipe gesture action
features.description: Configure the swipe gesture action as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: choose what a swipe on a note does (archive or delete)

features.name: Configure checklist behaviour
features.description: Configure checklist behaviour as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: set whether checked items move to the bottom, whether they are kept or removed on save, and whether unchecked items are shown first

features.name: Configure notification behaviour for reminders
features.description: Configure notification behaviour for reminders as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: set the notification sound, vibration, LED and snooze delay

features.name: Set the password and recovery question
features.description: Set the password and recovery question as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: enter the recovery question and answer

features.name: View the app version, changelog and licences
features.description: View the app version, changelog and licences as documented for Omni Notes.
actions: tap it to read the version, the changelog, the privacy policy and the open-source licences
